title: Compound Interest Explained: How $100 a Month Becomes $239,000
alts: A Penny Doubled for 30 Days Beats $1 Million
Why Starting 10 Years Earlier Beats Investing 3x More
line1: What is compound interest? It's interest on interest, and it's why $100 a month can grow to ~$239,000, and why credit card debt explodes.
summary: Would Dave take $1 million or a penny that doubles for 30 days? We explain compound interest with snowballs and pennies, why Dave beats Bob by starting 10 years earlier with a third of the money, the rule of 72, Warren Buffett's real superpower, the dark side of compounding debt, and the snowball thieves.
